parameter_set.description: The HYDRA graphite/LNMO parameter set of Schmitt et al. 2026 with both electrode OCP tables replaced by average-branch p-OCV curves of Flores et al. 2026 (graphite Gr-AQ-1, LNMO LNMO-AQ-2), and the open-circuit voltages at 0% and 100% SOC in User-defined recomputed for them at HYDRA's stoichiometry windows. A virtual cell: the Flores LNMO is another powder, and no cell with these OCPs was measured, so the Validation section is removed. Everything else is HYDRA's, including its kinetics: each electrode's reaction-rate constant is a single BPX value fitted to a BattMo j0(soc) table.

provenance.source_name: Schmitt et al. 2026 and Flores et al. 2026

notes: Parameters from Schmitt et al. 2026, 'Comprehensive parameter and electrochemical dataset for a 1 Ah graphite/LNMO battery cell for physical modelling' (arXiv:2601.10507), released by the authors under CC-BY-4.0, as in their BPX file (https://w3id.org/battinfo/dataset/7jnc-cjtw-5h3a-5t52). Both electrode OCPs are from the half-cell p-OCV data of Flores et al. 2026 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20086298, CC-BY-4.0). Changes: the OCP tables were replaced, the User-defined open-circuit voltages at 0% and 100% SOC were recomputed for them at HYDRA's stoichiometry windows, and the Validation section was removed.
A virtual cell: the Flores LNMO is another powder than HYDRA's, and no cell with these OCPs was measured.
